_comment: Regression gate, not a quality claim: each limit sits below what the reference
run measured on UHR/HBR (docs/RNASEQ.md), so a run fails only when it is clearly
worse. Mapping and strand limits suit a stranded human library; ERCC limits use
the theory of a linear assay (slope 1) with room for the measured spread; the
subgroup bias is in log2 units after the mRNA-fraction offset is removed.
Recalibrate after changing the aligner, the annotation or the data.
